about_title: About Xiamen Hongfa Electroacoustic Co., Ltd. (HONGFA)
about_global_leader: Today, HONGFA has grown into a leader in the global relay industry.
about_branches_count: HONGFA has more than 30 subsidiaries worldwide
about_business_scope: Our business covers over 120 countries and regions, including: relays, medium and low voltage electrical equipment, high and low voltage complete sets of equipment, connectors, capacitors, precision parts, and automation equipment. HONGFA has established 3 R&D and production bases in China (Xiamen-Zhangzhou, East and West) and a factory in Indonesia. This has enabled the creation of a complete industry chain and a wide product assortment.
about_mission_text: HONGFA is committed to providing customers with satisfactory products and solutions, and to making people's lives more convenient and easier through continuous innovation and pursuit of high quality.

app_household_desc: Hongfa supports world-class household appliance brands with a complete range of relay specifications for air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, and other applications.
app_new_energy_desc: Hongfa provides high-voltage DC relays, photovoltaic relays, contactors, electronic circuit breakers, capacitors, and other products for photovoltaic, wind power, new energy vehicles, and charging piles.
app_industrial_desc: As a professional manufacturer of industrial relays and contactors, Hongfa provides products for major industrial control and automation companies worldwide.
app_automotive_desc: Hongfa maintains stable relationships with world-renowned OEM and Tier1 suppliers. Hongfa provides automotive relays, high-voltage DC relays, BCM, BDU, PDU, and oxygen sensors.

products_relays_desc: Hongfa relay products include power relays (general purpose relays), automotive relays, high-voltage DC relays (DC contactors), latching relays, signal relays, industrial relays, and others. We also provide matching relay sockets. Hongfa relays cover over 160 series and more than 40,000 general specifications, with an annual production capacity exceeding 3 billion units. Products are certified with UL / C-UL, VDE, TÜV, CQC, and other safety certifications.
